jobs.title: Product Owner, Accounting Stack (entire Business Suite)
jobs.jd_full:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: Remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

--------

You will own Flex's Accountants Stack. Accounting integrations, expense management, bill pay, invoicing, AR and AP, and financial reporting. The full set of tools that closely held business owners and the accountants who serve them use to run the financial operations of the company.

The accountant is the lead persona for this role. Bookkeepers, controllers, fractional CFOs, and outside CPAs are the people who actually live in this software day to day. Build for them and the owner wins by default. Build only for the owner and the accountant works around you, which means you lose.

The reason this role exists at Flex and not at every fintech is the unique customer we serve. Super premium business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue have a controller or an outside accountant, real ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, sometimes Microsoft Dynamics or Acumatica), and a layered financial life where the business and personal sides are deeply intertwined. The owner pays themselves a distribution, then funds personal investments, then pays for an asset, then expenses something back through the company. Their accountant has to make all of it tie out. We are the only product positioned to make that integrated life elegant for both sides. This role builds it.

You will not build a generic accounting integration. You will build the Accountants Stack that bookkeepers, controllers, and CPAs actually want, which means knowing what they hate about QuickBooks, what they love about NetSuite, what they wish Bill.com did, and where the seams between business and personal finance create the most friction today.

What you will do

----------------

Define the strategy and own the connectivity layer to the accounting and ERP systems our customers' accountants use. QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, etc.

Build expense management that works for owners and the accountants reconciling on their behalf. Receipt capture, GL coding, approval workflows, integration into the accounting tools without requiring manual reconciliation downstream.

Own bill pay and AR/AP. The workflow from invoice received to vendor paid, from invoice sent to customer paid, with full reconciliation back to the accounting system.

Build the invoicing product. We do not have a real invoicing offering today and customers are starting to ask. Decide what shape it takes and ship it.

Architect the connection between business financial data and personal financial data. This is the wedge no other fintech has. Make the integrated owner life real in product so the accountant can deliver it cleanly.

Partner closely with the Banking, Credit, Cards, and Payments product owners so financial flows tie out cleanly across the stack. No seams. No reconciliation tax for the accountant or the customer.

Translate the controller, CFO, and CPA persona for the rest of the company. We need someone who speaks both owner and accountant fluently. And can translate it to the owner mindset.

What you will need

------------------

You have spent years thinking about how business owners and the accountants who serve them actually run financial operations. You know the difference between a bookkeeper, a controller, a fractional CFO, and an outside accountant, and you have built product for at least one of them.

Deep, hands-on familiarity with at least two of: QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Acumatica. Not "I know they exist." Actually built in or integrated to them at depth.

You can journal a transaction without looking it up. You understand accrual versus cash basis, the close cycle, what a 1099 is for, and why a controller cares about the audit trail.

You have built either inside an accounting platform, on top of one as an integration partner, or built a fintech product that lives natively in the accounting workflow.

You understand the accountant channel and how CPAs influence product adoption. Bonus if you have built for or partnered with CPAs directly.

Typically 4 to 10 years of experience. Title is not the point.

Compensation

Additional Information

We want to hear from you. We value passion, determination, and honesty. If you do not match every line of the spec but you can show us the work, apply anyway. Unusual paths and rare skills are how you stand out at Flex.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Envato

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.
We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.
We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.
You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

About the role

Envato is an all in one creative asset toolkit, bringing together world class creative assets and AI tools to help creative professionals bring their ideas to life.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to join Envato on a contract basis and help us deliver some important product work.

This isn’t a role where you’ll spend your first few months developing a new product vision or writing a strategy from scratch. We already know where we’re heading.

What we need is a great Product Manager who can come in, get across a complex product area quickly and help us turn that direction into something customers can actually use.

You’ll work closely with our Product, Design and Engineering teams, taking complex initiatives from discovery and definition through to launch, measurement and iteration.

We’re looking for a safe pair of hands. Someone who knows how to bring clarity when things are messy, make sensible calls, spot issues early and keep work moving without needing a lot of oversight.

What you’ll be doing

  • You’ll take ownership of product initiatives and help turn established strategy and priorities into clear, actionable work. Then execute on this.
  • You’ll use customer insight, data and commercial context to navigate trade offs, keep delivery moving and find smarter ways of working through AI, automation and agents.
  • The emphasis is on execution with judgement. You’ll have plenty of autonomy, but you’ll be working within an established product direction rather than being expected to redefine it.

What we’re looking for

  • You’ve worked as a senior Product Manager in a SaaS, technology or digital product business and have enough experience under your belt to step into complex work without needing everything mapped out for you.
  • You know how to take an initiative from an ambiguous starting point through to something shipped, measured and improved. You’re comfortable working with engineers and designers, can make trade offs when there isn’t a perfect answer and know when to make the call yourself versus when to pull others in.
  • You’ll have strong product judgement, customer empathy and commercial awareness, and be comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions.
  • We also want someone who is AI fluent. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using AI as part of how you think and work. Experience with GenAI products, AI enabled experiences or agents would be a bonus.

    • Why Envato?

  • Our product is evolving quickly. Creative workflows are changing, AI is becoming part of everyday creative work and expectations around speed and what creative tools can do are moving with it. We’re building for the way creative professionals work now, while leaving plenty of room for what comes next.
  • If you like getting into the work, solving messy problems with good people and seeing things actually ship, you’ll enjoy this one.

Life at Envato

• Flexible Working: remote-first across Australia or New Zealand with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need
• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.
• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.
• Learning Budget: study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.
• Home Office Allowance: a contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.
• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.
• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.
• Parental Leave:20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave.
We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.
By submitting your application you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. If you would like to understand how we handle personal information before submitting your application, please read through our Privacy Policy.
Research shows candidates from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds often only apply for roles if they meet all the criteria. We like to make our hiring decisions based on lived experience, so if you’re keen to apply and need reasonable adjustments please let us know.

jobs.title: AI Technical Product Manager (QVAC) (100% remote)
jobs.jd_full:
Description

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate theQV.ACvision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.

  • Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.

  • Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.

  • Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.

  • Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.

  • Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.

  • Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.

  • Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance toQV.AC. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.

  • Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.

  • A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.

  • The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.

  • Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.

  • Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

  • Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.

  • Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.

  • Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.

  • An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.

  • Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.

  • Experience working in a distributed team.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Why Join Us?

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch’s P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world’s leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don’t need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else’s servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Please Note: This is a Utah-based hybrid position which will require some regular in-office days each week. Additionally, employment with BambooHR is contingent on passing both a background and credit check.

AI at BambooHR

At BambooHR, we’re all about setting people free to do great work, and we believe AI is a powerful partner in that mission. We’re leaning into intelligent tools to streamline our workflows, giving us more time for high-impact innovation. We look for curious, forward-thinking people who are ready to explore how AI can elevate their work and help us reimagine the future of HR.

Essential Job Duties

A better customer experience starts with people who can turn a big goal into a delivered outcome. As a Program Manager on our Customer Experience (CX) Programs team, you’ll own a portfolio of connected projects that improves how BambooHR serves its customers. Your work will support priorities such as customer retention, service efficiency, and AI-enabled customer experiences, with a direct connection to our CX strategy.

You’ll partner with CX leadership and teams across the business to define success, choose the right work, and deliver measurable results. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll lead projects yourself, support project managers within your portfolio, and help teammates grow through coaching and thoughtful feedback.

Who Thrives in This Role?

You stay focused on the outcome while remaining flexible about how to get there. You can get a first plan in front of stakeholders, learn from their feedback, and move the work forward without waiting for every detail to be settled. You recover quickly when priorities shift or a project stops. You learn unfamiliar domains, tools, and data well enough to contribute quickly, and you take ownership of getting the work across the finish line. When the evidence calls for a change, you help others understand why and move with it.

You will:

  • Turn ambiguous business needs into clear program goals, practical plans, and shared accountability.
  • Define baselines, leading indicators, and outcome measures so teams can ensure that improvements are sustained.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities, then sequence projects around capacity, dependencies, and expected impact. Make tradeoff calls when priorities compete, and promptly escalate decisions that require leadership input to keep work moving.
  • Lead programs from discovery and testing through implementation, adoption, and measurement, including work already in progress.
  • Bring the right people together, build alignment, resolve blockers, and keep decisions moving across teams you do not manage. Identify dependency, resourcing, and sequencing risks across programs, and work with teams across the organization to address them before they slow delivery.
  • Give senior leaders clear updates on results, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed, with data-supported recommendations they can act on.
  • Use evidence to adjust direction, including pausing or stopping work when a different approach better serves the goal.
  • Help teams adopt new ways of working by planning and leading change across multiple teams using a structured approach, such as ADKAR, that includes stakeholder analysis, communication, training, and reinforcement after launch.
  • Coach project managers and use AI to improve program delivery and customer-facing processes.

What You Need to Get the Job Done

  • Experience owning complex, cross-functional programs or initiatives from problem definition through delivery, with measurable business results.
  • The ability to create a workable plan when the problem, scope, or path forward is still taking shape, and improve it as you learn.
  • Strong stakeholder relationships and the ability to influence decisions, resolve competing priorities, and drive progress without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including experience advising senior leaders on priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.
  • Experience defining KPIs, interpreting data, and using evidence to prioritize work and evaluate outcomes.
  • Experience guiding teams through organizational or process change and helping new approaches take hold.
  • Practical experience using AI in your work, with examples of how it improves your thinking, execution, or process design.

What Will Make Us REALLY Love You

  • Experience improving customer retention, service delivery, operational efficiency, or digital customer experiences.
  • Experience in SaaS, HR, or payroll. We also welcome operations, consulting, technical program management, and PMO backgrounds with meaningful ownership across functions.
  • Examples of redesigning a workflow around AI and coaching other project managers to deliver stronger results.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • A Great Company Culture that has been recognized by multiple organizations like Inc, and Salt Lake Tribune
  • Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance
  • Generous leave policies that include 4 weeks of vacation, 12 company holidays, parental leave, and volunteer time off so you can enjoy quality of life
  • 401k plans with up to 6% company match
  • $2000 Paid-Paid Vacation bonus
  • EAP through Headspace
  • Check out all our benefits that benefit you

About Us

At BambooHR, we’re building something different: we’re building a people intelligence platform that transforms HR and sets people free to do great work! We’re a proven market leader driving innovation while building lasting success through thoughtful, sustainable growth. Here, you’ll find a place that champions growth: both professional and personal, both individual and collective.

We invest in potential, giving you the space to stretch your capabilities and turn good ideas into reality while providing the safety net of a supportive, values-driven culture. Our approach combines meaningful work with meaningful lives, offering competitive benefits, professional development, and the flexibility to thrive both in and outside the office.

What sets us apart isn’t just what we do, but how we do it: with openness, integrity, and a shared commitment to doing the right thing. Join us in creating HR software that makes work better for everyone, while we make work better for you.

BambooHR is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals and will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.  If you would like to request accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

BambooHR is An Equal Opportunity Employer–M/F/D/V Because our team members are trusted to handle sensitive information, we require all candidates that receive and accept employment offers to complete a background check before being hired.

For information on California Privacy Policy, click here.

Our process utilizes AI as an assistant to efficiently process and analyze candidate data. Recruiters and hiring managers maintain full oversight and accountability, ensuring that all final selection and rejection decisions are human-made and based solely on objective job qualifications. Please see our General Privacy Notice and California Privacy Notice for more details.

See our AI Guidelines for Candidates for details on how BambooHR uses AI in recruiting, how we expect candidates to use AI, and what is not allowed.

jobs.title: Agile Delivery Manager (Public Sector)
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

Are you ready to join the forefront of technology innovation with Netcompany?

As one of the fastest growing technology companies, we are disrupting the marketplace and revolutionizing the way businesses operate. Our vision is to be the leading digital challenger in Europe whilst evolving the next generation of IT consulting.

Operating across both public and private sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of services from application development and seamless cloud migration to program delivery and service operations, our offerings are designed to meet diverse business needs.

Job Description

Netcompany is looking for a Senior Agile Delivery Manager to drive forward our delivery capability and deliver the optimum solutions to the clients. As a Delivery Manager, in our Application Development unit, you will be working on a variety of projects. Based in London or Leeds, this is a great opportunity to join one of the most exciting, innovative, prestigious and forward-thinking technology-enabled organisations in the UK.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex digital services, ensuring agreed outcomes are achieved within scope, budget, timescales and quality expectations.
  • Provide hands-on agile delivery leadership across one or more multidisciplinary teams, adapting ways of working to the delivery context and undertaking Scrum Master responsibilities where appropriate, including facilitating planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement.
  • Create the conditions for effective agile delivery by removing blockers, managing dependencies and helping teams continuously improve how they work.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to translate product strategy and priorities into achievable delivery plans, balancing user needs, business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams comprising delivery, product, engineering, architecture, quality assurance, business analysis, data and user-centred design professionals, building team capability and supporting individuals to grow and perform effectively.
  • Ensure user-centred design disciplines, including user research, service design, interaction design and content design, are integrated throughout delivery.
  • Support services through the GDS delivery lifecycle, from Discovery and Alpha through Beta and Live, ensuring alignment with the Government Service Standard and Technology Code of Practice.
  • Plan and coordinate GDS service assessments, including assessment readiness, evidence gathering, team preparation and the management of recommendations arising from assessments.
  • Maintain effective delivery controls, including delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency management, resource forecasting, governance reporting and stakeholder communications.
  • Take a hands-on approach to Jira and Confluence, ensuring backlogs, workflows, dashboards, documentation, decisions and delivery reporting are accurate and actively maintained.
  • Manage delivery across complex technology environments involving system integration, legacy platforms, cloud services and third-party suppliers.
  • Provide clear and transparent reporting on delivery progress, risks, dependencies, finances and outcomes to senior management, clients and governance forums.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients, stakeholders, suppliers and team members, constructively challenging decisions where required to protect delivery outcomes.
  • Contribute to the wider delivery management community through knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues.

Qualifications

  • Extensive experience of leading complex digital or technology delivery within government or the wider public sector.
  • Strong practical knowledge of agile delivery methods, alongside experience of traditional and hybrid delivery approaches, with the ability to select and adapt the most appropriate with experience performing both Delivery Manager and Scrum Master responsibilities.
  • Demonstrable experience of leading multidisciplinary digital teams that include Product Management, engineering, quality assurance, business analysis and user-centred design professionals.
  • Strong understanding of the respective accountabilities of Delivery Managers and Product Managers, with evidence of effective collaboration to manage priorities, roadmaps and delivery outcomes.
  • Practical experience of working through the GDS delivery lifecycle and applying the Government Service Standard.
  • Experience of preparing teams and services for GDS service assessments, responding to assessor feedback and implementing recommendations.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience of Jira and Confluence or other project management tools including backlog management, workflows, dashboards, reporting and delivery documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of the software delivery lifecycle, including Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live and ongoing service improvement.
  • Experience of delivery planning, dependency management, risk and issue management, resource forecasting and governance reporting.
  • Experience of managing system integration initiatives involving multiple technologies, delivery teams and third-party suppliers.
  • Proven ability to remove delivery blockers, manage competing priorities and create an environment in which teams can deliver effectively.
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching and servant-leadership skills, with the ability to embed agile behaviours and drive continuous improvement.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to build trust, communicate complex delivery matters clearly and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.
  • Experience of contributing to a professional community through knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring.
  • A recognised agile delivery or Scrum Master qualification, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
  • Willingness to work within a hybrid model and travel occasionally to client or delivery locations.

Additional Information

Benefits include

  • Hybrid working model with some flexible working
  • 25 days’ holiday
  • Private Medical Health care via Vitality
  • Pension contribution, Life Assurance
  • Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
  • A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
  • Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.

Company information

Join Netcompany, where we proudly hold the 5th position on the esteemed UK Top 50 Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Awards for 2024.

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe’s most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.

Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us.  We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at [email protected].

jobs.title: Project Manager, Delivery Lead
jobs.jd_full:
Suvoda is a global clinical trial technology company shaping digital experiences that enable clinical trial sponsor and site professionals to take full command over the inherent logistical complexity behind mission-critical and time-sensitive patient interactions in life-sustaining studies for therapeutic areas such as oncology, central nervous system, and rare disease.

Supporting clinical trials means supporting unique experiments that are inherently complex, high-stakes, and dynamic. It is imperative that Suvoda staff working with clients, end-users, or the systems that client and end-users interact with understand the clinical trial industry, regulations, Suvoda’s software products and processes, and especially the specificities of the unique trial in question before taking any actions they may alter the data of the system in question.

Project Manager, Delivery Lead Responsibilities:

  • Lead a cross-functional project team responsible for the delivery of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) for randomization and drug supply management
  • Manage client expectations regarding project timelines, delivery, scope, and internal and external responsibilities
  • Lead the client Kick-Off Meeting covering project timelines, delivery, and scope including communication of internal and external expectations
  • Supports the specification review meetings internally and externally
  • Manage schedule and scope for all projects; track all tasks required to deliver systems on-time for client user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Facilitate internal and external meetings for all assigned projects
  • Set meeting agenda, share meeting minutes, and drive completion of action items internally and externally
  • Proactively assess project risks and escalate issues via established internal and external communication pathways
  • Drives study resourcing with support and input from project team members
  • Ensure client satisfaction throughout the project build and maintenance phase, working with customer care, Suvoda management, and business development as needed
  • Identify and assist with the implementation of process improvements for the services department
  • Assist the product team with the design and development of new features by providing feedback based on client requests and project experience
  • Assist the Product team and Services Solutions with the design and development of new features and initiatives by providing feedback based on client requests and project experience
  • Delegate and oversee tasks to associate project managers
  • Travel to client sites to attend meetings and conduct user training sessions
  • Perform other related duties as required

Additional Responsibilities:

Project Management:

  • Lead team in effort to achieve scorecard targets related to capacity, compliance efficiency, quality and engagement
  • Primary point of contact for the client from contract award through system de-activation and archival, leading status meetings, tracking all open issues or questions, and providing status updates as required
  • Own responsibilities for project timelines, quality, team utilization and on-time delivery; delegate and manage tasks and responsibilities across the team
  • Manage schedule and scope for all projects; track all tasks required to deliver systems on-time for client user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Drive overall team resourcing efforts with support and input from project team members
  • Support the training and development of new team members
  • Travel to client sites to attend meetings and conduct user training sessions

Team Management:

  • Direct management and supervision responsibilities for team members including delegating, directing, and monitoring progress on assigned work
  • Collaborating with Services Managers on performance management and development for their team members
  • Providing input on priorities, giving formal feedback and participating for Performance Check-Ins in partnership with the League Lead and Services Manager (Coach)
  • Identifying and assigning learning opportunities to the appropriate team members, with input and collaboration from the Services Manager
  • Collaboratively working with team members to address challenges, solve problems and remove obstacles as needed
  • Build and maintain a strong sense of belonging and connection within the team
  • Proactively monitor performance of team members, soliciting and providing meaningful feedback
  • Meet regularly with team members to check-in on priorities and support needs

Operational Management:

  • Collaborate with League Leadership in ongoing assignment of studies
  • Participate in hiring process and decisions for the Services Delivery department
  • Participate in and manage roll-out of process improvements and corporate updates in Services within their League
  • Serve as an expert and internal escalation point of contact for team members in Services in and outside of team
  • Partner with Solutions, Talent & Culture, and Learning & Development to ensure training and best practices are delivered across the team
  • Provide support related to Issue Management as required
  • Perform other related duties as required

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
  • Interpersonal and communication skills
  • Time management and organizational skill
  • Analytical thinking ability
  • Creative problem-solving ability
  • Attention to detail
  • Consultative skills

Experience:

  • At least two years of experience in IRT or related field preferred
